exercises.instruction: В некоторых предложениях допущена ошибка. Где нужно, исправьте ошибку.

items.prompt: A thief is a person which steals things.
An airplane is a machine that flies.
A coffee maker is a machine who makes coffee.
What’s happened to the money that was on the table?
answers: What’s happened to the money which was on the table?

items.prompt: I don’t like people which never stop talking.
I know somebody that can help you.
answers: I know somebody who can help you.

items.prompt: I know somebody who works in that shop.
answers: I know somebody that works in that shop.

items.prompt: Correct the sentences who are wrong.
My neighbour bought a car who cost £40,000.

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. (по соседству = next door; в течение = for; течь через = flow through; статья = article; (8) на = for)

items.prompt: Люди, которые живут по соседству, очень шумные.
answers: The people who live next door are very noisy.
The people that live next door are very noisy.

items.prompt: У меня есть друг, который жил в Токио в течение 5 лет.
answers: I have a friend who lived in Tokyo for 5 years.
I have got a friend who lived in Tokyo for 5 years.

items.prompt: Вы знаете кого-нибудь, кто говорит по-итальянски?
answers: Do you know anyone who speaks Italian?
Do you know anyone that speaks Italian?

items.prompt: Нева – это река, которая течёт через Петербург.
answers: The Neva is the river which flows through Petersburg.
The Neva is the river that flows through Petersburg.

items.prompt: Ты видела книю, которая была на столе?
answers: Have you seen the book which was on the table?
Have you seen the book that was on the table?
Did you see the book which was on the table?
Did you see the book that was on the table?

items.prompt: Журналист – это человек, который пишет статьи.
answers: A journalist is a person who writes articles.
A journalist is a person that writes articles.

items.prompt: Это та девушка, которая украла твой кошелёк?
answers: Is that the girl who stole your wallet?
Is that the girl that stole your wallet?

items.prompt: Карен работает на компанию, которая производит компьютеры.
answers: Karen works for a company which makes computers.
Karen works for a company that makes computers.
